assertion_results.description: At least one eval record has a grade assigned
At least one eval record carries an ISO last_graded timestamp (the skill's actual deliverable is in-place grading updates to eval records, not a standalone output file)
At least one graded eval record has substantive grader_notes (>20 chars) explaining the grade rationale

grading.grader_notes: Cowork-hook capture of a rigby-eval-grade invocation: status success in 10.8 seconds with zero steps. Its 3 assertions (records-graded, grading-stamped, notes-substantive) are global-state checks - 'at least one eval record has a grade' - that pass vacuously because older records carry grades, not because this run graded anything. As a record of skill execution it contains no evidence of work and claims a success the record itself cannot support. Recommend either quarantining cowork-hook records like the phantom-candidate class, or tightening eval-grade assertions to require last_graded timestamps newer than the run's own start time.
